title: How I Audit a Creator Funnel — Content to Purchase, Metric by Metric

sections.label: 1 · CONTENT → ENGAGEMENT
sections.note: Before judging anything downstream, I map exactly where the engagement comes from and how much of it ever turns into a lead.

sections.label: 2 · LEAD CAPTURE
sections.note: Every point where a comment or follower is asked to become a lead gets checked on its own capture rate.

sections.label: 3 · LANDING PAGE & CHECKOUT
sections.note: Where people actually drop off between clicking and paying, measured, not assumed.

sections.label: 4 · FOLLOW-UP & RETARGETING
sections.note: Every automation trigger, follow-up sequence, and retargeting audience checked against what it actually recovers.

sections.label: 5 · ATTRIBUTION & DASHBOARD
sections.note: The whole journey traced end to end, so the dashboard shows comments to purchases and the recommendations are backed by real numbers.

input_sample.expected: A clear call to action on every high-engagement post, converting comments into captured emails
input_sample.actual: Comments get replies but no capture step, engagement dies on the platform instead of entering the funnel

output_sample.highest_revenue_leak: Lead Capture: high engagement with no capture step, the biggest gap between attention and revenue
output_sample.dashboard_delivered: Comments → Leads → Checkouts → Purchases, by content piece
output_sample.stack_recommendation: Current CRM is fine, the leak is process, not software
